title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.
  • Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination.
  • Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.
  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.
  • Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly.
  • Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer

Location: Brazil, Costa Rica, Colombia

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits; candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months, with strong possibility of extension

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

We are supporting a large Vendor Platform Transformation initiative focused on rebuilding vendor onboarding and intake systems. The team manages vendor relations and custom intake workflows for bulk item onboarding.

This is a backend-heavy role with approximately 90% backend and 10% frontend work. The primary focus for the next year+ will be Ruby and Elixir systems, though strong backend engineers with experience in Java, Kotlin, C# or Go will also be considered.

The team is looking for engineers with strong backend fundamentals, scalable systems experience and solid coding and system design skills who can reliably deliver high-quality software in distributed environments.


Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives
  • Develop backend systems primarily using Elixir and Ruby, with supporting technologies including React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to technical decisions that shape the future of software systems
  • Build scalable and production-ready web applications and distributed systems
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers
  • Collaborate with team members through pairing sessions and shared feature development
  • Deploy user-facing code to production environments
  • Partner closely with product and engineering management teams
  • Continuously learn and apply new technologies, software design patterns, and engineering practices


Must-Have Skills

  • Minimum 5 years of software engineering experience
  • Strong backend development experience with scalable/distributed systems
  • Strong coding and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with Ruby and Elixir preferred for current project needs
  • Strong backend expertise in Java, Kotlin, C#, or Go will also be considered

  • Understanding of system design fundamentals and distributed systems concepts
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools
  • Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals, and GraphQL
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Passion for testing practices and continuous improvement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Storybook
  • Experience building eCommerce platforms

  • Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the luxury consignment market, and sustainable commerce

title: Technical Project Manager
description:

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.
  • Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination.
  • Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.
  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.
  • Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly.
  • Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

title: Especialista em Customer Success
description:

  • Cultura colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você é o ponto de contato direto entre o cliente e a Adaflow. Atende com autonomia, escuta com atenção, diagnostica com critério e resolve com precisão. Cada interação vira contexto, cada problema vira aprendizado, cada feedback vira melhoria.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Atuar na linha de frente nos canais oficiais da Adaflow: WhatsApp, e-mail, chat na plataforma/site e no sistema de tickets, mantendo sempre o tom de voz da empresa.
  • Ler o histórico do cliente antes de atender. Contexto é o que diferencia um atendimento bom de um excelente.
  • Acompanhar cada chamado do início ao fim, garantindo o cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Realizar follow-up ativo para confirmar a resolução dos problemas e medir a satisfação (NPS, CSAT).
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes sempre que o caso exigir um alinhamento mais próximo.
  • Conhecer profundamente o serviço prestado e o funcionamento do produto.
  • Diagnosticar problemas relatados, identificar a causa raiz e propor soluções adequadas, sem depender de roteiros engessados.
  • Prestar suporte de níveis 1 e 2, escalando casos complexos às áreas responsáveis quando necessário.
  • Orientar clientes sobre o uso correto da plataforma, de produtos, serviços e funcionalidades.
  • Sinalizar imediatamente sinais de cancelamento e de risco de churn, acionando as áreas responsáveis para ações de retenção.
  • Documentar todas as interações, soluções aplicadas e feedbacks no sistema, mantendo o histórico do cliente sempre atualizado e útil.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a base de conhecimento (FAQ, artigos de ajuda, scripts de atendimento), transformando aprendizados do dia a dia em material reaproveitável pelo time.
  • Identificar padrões recorrentes de problemas e abrir tickets estruturados para os times de produto, engenharia, operações ou tecnologia, com contexto suficiente para acelerar a solução.
  • Coletar, consolidar e traduzir o feedback dos clientes em aprendizado real para o produto e os processos. Não é só registrar: é interpretar, priorizar e comunicar com contexto para quem decide.
  • Mapear padrões, identificar pontos de atrito e propor melhorias na experiência ponta a ponta é parte central do trabalho, não um extra.
  • Acompanhar indicadores como tempo de resposta e de adoção, usando os dados para tomar decisões, propor mudanças e comunicar o status de forma proativa.
  • Antecipar problemas antes que o cliente precise abrir um chamado. Atendimento de verdade é o que evita o próximo ticket.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência prática em atendimento ou no sucesso do cliente, especialmente em tecnologia, contabilidade, SaaS ou Fintech.
  • Noções sobre rotinas financeiras, contábeis e/ou fiscais: você não precisa ser contador(a), mas precisa entender o contexto do cliente.
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal excelente: clara, direta e empática.
  • Visão analítica: volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e CSAT fazem parte do seu dia a dia.
  • Autonomia real para atuar em ambiente remoto e dinâmico. Você organiza o próprio trabalho.
  • Repertório de ferramentas: Cloud Humans, Intercom, Take Blip, Zendesk, Zenvia, Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares. 
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com clientes insatisfeitos.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda. 
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita: somos uma empresa global.
  • Formação em contabilidade ou estudantes de ciências contábeis.
  • Experiência em documentação de processos/Help Center.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e métricas de CS: Notion, Looker Studio, planilhas avançadas.
  • Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e produto: você busca entender como funciona o que está atendendo.


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você precisa de um script para tomar uma decisão, de alguém te dizendo o que fazer a cada passo, ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, há muitas empresas por aí que vão te receber bem. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer elevar o atendimento de uma empresa que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, aprender rápido, evoluir com quem coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

description:

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. Analista de Integração | CLT | 100% Home Office

  • VR ou VA de R$ 32/dia útil
  • Plano de Saúde Amil sem desconto em folha (apenas taxa de coparticipação. OBS - válido apenas para o titular)

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil Remote

Department: Engineering

Employment Type: Contract (B2B)

Contract Length: 6 months


About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay. We’re a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.


About the role:

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team building innovative products. We're looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You're also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.


Your day-to-day responsibilities can look like this:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust backend and infrastructure systems using Golang and Java with contributions across the broader engineering stack
  • Work closely with client teams in collaborative working sessions, explaining technical decisions and translating complex engineering concepts clearly
  • Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux
  • Actively leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and drive engineering best practices


Preferred skills:

  • Strong backend and infrastructure engineering background, with hands-on Golang and Java experience;
  • Experience developing or integrating decentralised systems, data infrastructure, or distributed technologies;
  • Solid command of cloud infrastructure: AWS , GCP , Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux ;
  • Actively and meaningfully using AI tools in day-to-day coding practice (not just awareness, but advanced, habitual use);
  • Familiarity with TigerBeetle, YugabyteDB, or Red Panda;
  • Experience in fintech, core banking, or regulated financial services environments;
  • Open to occasional travel to London.


You should apply if you are:

  • Proactive: You take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be asked;
  • A strong communicator: you express technical ideas clearly, in writing and in client-facing conversations, with full professional fluency in English;
  • Confident presenting: you bring a polished, engaged attitude to working sessions and stakeholder interactions;
  • Focused on quality: you care about doing things properly and hold yourself to a high standard;
  • Pragmatic: you make sensible trade-offs and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments;
  • A creative problem solver: you approach hard engineering challenges with curiosity and ingenuity;
  • Collaborative: you thrive on working within cross-functional, distributed teams and value others' input.


What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business


Our typical recruitment process:

  • 1st Interview with someone from the Talent team (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)


Get a glimpse of what it's like working at YLD!

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: Consultor de Estratégia e Transformação Digital | Industry & Services
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Estratégia e Transformação Digital | Industry & Services em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um consultor sênior para integrar o time de advisory e pré-vendas da vertical Industry & Services, com foco em estratégia, transformação digital e operações industriais. Atuará no diagnóstico de problemas de negócio, na estruturação de soluções e na condução de conversas estratégicas com clientes, traduzindo oportunidades operacionais em propostas de valor sustentadas por tecnologia, dados e IA.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir discovery, diagnósticos operacionais e mapeamento de processos em clientes de óleo e gás, mineração, manufatura e setores correlatos, identificando oportunidades de eficiência e modernização.
  • Estruturar soluções de transformação digital, conectando dores de negócio a iniciativas de tecnologia, automação, analytics e IA generativa.
  • Construir propostas, decks executivos e materiais consultivos com qualidade e velocidade para suportar o ciclo de pré-vendas e conversas com lideranças do cliente.
  • Conduzir interações client facing com áreas de negócio e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas, priorização e clareza de valor.
  • Articular o ecossistema interno (especialistas, delivery, parceiros) para montar respostas integradas dentro dos prazos comerciais.
  • Apoiar a evolução do portfólio de ofertas da vertical, trazendo leitura de mercado, tendências e cases que inspirem novas oportunidades.


Perfil que buscamos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas, com pós-graduação ou MBA considerados um diferencial.
  • Experiência sólida em consultoria (Big 4, boutiques de estratégia ou integradores) atuando em projetos de transformação digital, supply chain, operações ou estratégia para clientes industriais.
  • Vivência em diagnóstico de processos, modelagem de soluções e gestão de iniciativas em ambientes complexos e multidisciplinares.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura de Dados, AI/GenAI, Machine Learning e componentes Cloud.
  • Familiaridade com temas de Indústria 4.0, convergência IT/OT, supply chain analytics, gestão de ativos, torre de controle ou aplicações de IA em operações.
  • Domínio de Power BI e Excel avançado; conhecimentos de Python, SQL ou plataformas de dados são bem-vindos.
  • Inglês avançado para interlocução com fornecedores, parceiros e times globais.
  • Postura consultiva, estruturação clara de raciocínio, velocidade na construção de materiais e energia para conduzir o ambiente e conectar pessoas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em projetos para Agro, Alimentos & Bebidas, Bens de Consumo, Auto, Mineradoras ou grandes indústrias de Manufatura.
  • Vivência prática em iniciativas com IA generativa, agentes de LLM ou analytics avançado aplicado a operações.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil Remote

Department: Engineering

Employment Type: Contract (B2B)

Contract Length: 6 months


About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay. We’re a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.


About the role:

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team building innovative products. We're looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You're also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.


Your day-to-day responsibilities can look like this:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust backend and infrastructure systems using Golang and Java with contributions across the broader engineering stack
  • Work closely with client teams in collaborative working sessions, explaining technical decisions and translating complex engineering concepts clearly
  • Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux
  • Actively leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and drive engineering best practices


Preferred skills:

  • Strong backend and infrastructure engineering background, with hands-on Golang and Java experience;
  • Experience developing or integrating decentralised systems, data infrastructure, or distributed technologies;
  • Solid command of cloud infrastructure: AWS , GCP , Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux ;
  • Actively and meaningfully using AI tools in day-to-day coding practice (not just awareness, but advanced, habitual use);
  • Familiarity with TigerBeetle, YugabyteDB, or Red Panda;
  • Experience in fintech, core banking, or regulated financial services environments;
  • Open to occasional travel to London.


You should apply if you are:

  • Proactive: You take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be asked;
  • A strong communicator: you express technical ideas clearly, in writing and in client-facing conversations, with full professional fluency in English;
  • Confident presenting: you bring a polished, engaged attitude to working sessions and stakeholder interactions;
  • Focused on quality: you care about doing things properly and hold yourself to a high standard;
  • Pragmatic: you make sensible trade-offs and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments;
  • A creative problem solver: you approach hard engineering challenges with curiosity and ingenuity;
  • Collaborative: you thrive on working within cross-functional, distributed teams and value others' input.


What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business


Our typical recruitment process:

  • 1st Interview with someone from the Talent team (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)


Get a glimpse of what it's like working at YLD!

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testes das funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.


Requisitos:


  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;


Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:


  • Conhecimento Contábil: Plano de Contas, Lançamentos Contábeis, Conciliações Contábeis, Conhecimento de obrigações Acessórias (ECD e ECF), Ativo Imobilizado, Depreciação e Amortização, CIAP, Contabilização de Folha de Pagamento, Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL, etc.

  • Familiaridade com análise de atualizações na legislação societária e normas contábeis;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/Node.js) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence.
  • Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets.
  • Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 2+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs.
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns.
  • Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools.
  • Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment.
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows.
  • Experience with AWS and working with databases.
  • Experience with SDUI and CI/CD.
  • Experience with flutter_bloc.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: HNW Client Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para HNW Client Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

PassBeyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. PassBeyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

  • Introduce PassBeyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network
  • Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision
  • Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand
  • Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics
  • Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

  • Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest
  • Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth
  • Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions
  • Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families
  • They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We're Looking For

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
